work.title: Move an Issue's Project status only when a run attacks the Work
work.description: The Project projection derives an Issue's status from the stage the Work is ready for, so the board advertises a stage no agent has started: complete Plan and the Issue jumps to Review while it only waits. The board should report activity, not readiness. A Work no run has attacked stays Backlog; a live run shows its stage; a Work waiting between runs keeps the stage last attacked; a terminal Work shows Done. Status changes remain reconciliation — a sync with no new run edits nothing.
acceptance: Starting a stage run moves the Work's Issue to that stage's Project status on the next sync
A Work waiting between stages keeps the status of the stage last attacked instead of advertising the stage it is ready for
A Work no run has ever attacked projects as Backlog, even one ready for Plan
A terminal Work still projects Done, and a sync with no new run edits no status
